title: pvHyperTreeGridEvaluateCoarse
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridEvaluateCoarse

Recomputes the values stored on refined (coarse) cells of a hyper tree grid from their children, for every cell array, with the chosen Operator: Min, Max, Sum, Average (masked children count as Default), Unmasked Average, Elder Child (the first child's value) or Splatting Average; the Don't change options leave coarse values as they are. Leaf values are unchanged. Use it before coarse-level views such as pvHyperTreeGridDepthLimiter so coarse cells summarise their children.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's initial Operator is Don't change fast, which does nothing; choose an operator explicitly.
- Sum and Average are not size-weighted in any physical unit; they combine child values directly.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridEvaluateCoarse`. Identity: `filters/HyperTreeGridEvaluateCoarse`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
